locale.name: invoice.settings.e-invoice.buyerEmailFallback.description
locale.en:
Used for electronic invoices if the invoice customer has no email address. Available placeholders:
  • %HASH% - Hash of the invoice
  • %ID% - Invoice ID
  • %INO% - Invoice number
  • %DATE% - Invoice date
  • %YEAR% - Year of the invoice date
  • %MONTH% - Month of the invoice date
  • %DAY% - Day of the invoice date
  • %CUSTOMER_ID% - Customer ID
  • %CUSTOMER_NO% - Customer number
  • %CUSTOMER_NAME% - Customer invoice name
  • %COMPANY% - Company
  • %FIRSTNAME% - First name
  • %LASTNAME% - Last name
Example: invoice-%INO%@example.com

Sets the product field whose content is used by default as the article description when an article is added to an invoice.

You can create a product field at Administration -> Shop -> Product fields with type text (normal or multilingual).

locale.en: Show EPC QR code on invoice

locale.name: invoice.settings.invoice.includeQrCode.description
locale.en: An EPC QR code is to be displayed on invoices with payment types invoice and prepayment. With this, all necessary payment information for SEPA transfers can be made available in common banking apps by scanning the QR code.

locale.name: invoice.settings.invoice.invoiceAddressRequirement.description
locale.en: If this option is checked, the invoice recipient address is required for all invoices, regardless of the amount. If this option is not checked, the address is only required once the threshold defined below is reached.

locale.name: invoice.invoiceAddressRequirementThreshold
locale.en: Threshold value for the address obligation

locale.name: invoice.invoiceAddressRequirementThreshold.description
locale.en: Here you can define the amount above which the full address of the invoice recipient is required. By default, this value is set to 200 euros in order to comply with the low-value regulation. This setting only affects the address entry if the address requirement is switched off.

locale.name: invoice.send.mail.message
locale.en:
[salutationText]

Your invoice (reference ID [invoiceId]) is attached to this e-mail as a PDF; just click on the attachment to access it.

You will need a PDF reader such as Adobe Acrobat Reader to view this invoice. If you do not yet have a reader installed, you can download one quickly, easily, and at no cost at all. To install the Acrobat Reader, just go to Acrobat's free download site or copy the following URL to your browser's address bar:
https://get.adobe.com/reader/

Your invoice is also available online in your account. Just click on "My invoices" or "My orders" to access them.

If you have any questions or remarks, please contact us by answering this e-mail. Our support team will contact you shortly.

All best wishes,
[systemCompany]
